title: The kite
logline: Tourist Season: a kite over the seawall, a tourist child holding the line, and its shadow on the wall crossing a man in plaid from behind and an old dog. The shadow's the only touch.

panels.composition: A seawall in July with a kite high above it on a line held by a tourist child, the kite's shadow falling across a man in plaid seen from behind and a small three-legged dog at his boot.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a seawall in July with a kite high above on a line held by a child and the kite's shadow falling across a man in plaid flannel seen from behind with a small three-legged dog at his boot, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
